# JYG Garment

> JYG Garment is a custom apparel manufacturer based in Guangzhou, Guangdong, China. It produces made-to-order garments for emerging fashion brands worldwide with a standard MOQ of 100 pieces per style, a 20-day lead time and a free design service.

## Key facts

- Business name: JYG Garment
- Business type: Custom apparel manufacturer (OEM / ODM custom garment production, private label)
- Location: Deli Originality Park Build A 1st Floor, Hebian street, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China
- Email: jyggarment@foxmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +86 13922181466
- Legal name: Guangzhou Jianyigou International Clothing Co., Ltd.
- Unified Social Credit Code (China): 91440104MAEH7NR51Y (verifiable at gsxt.gov.cn)
- Registered district: Yuexiu District, Guangzhou (code 440104); workshop and delivery address: Baiyun District
- Certifications: no certification numbers are claimed anywhere on this site; ask whether a specific scheme is held before ordering.
- Quality documentation available on request: mill-issued fabric test reports, third-party pre-shipment inspection, cut and QC records
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00-18:00 (GMT+8); buyers and third-party inspectors may visit in person
- Verification page: https://jyggarment.com/verify.html
- Alibaba.com storefront (jyggarment.en.alibaba.com) is discontinued and no longer operated by this company.
- Minimum order quantity: 100 pieces per style
- Standard lead time: 20 days from sample approval
- Facility: 5,000 sqm, 10+ production lines, 100+ skilled garment workers
- Annual capacity: 200,000 units
- Experience: 15+ years; third-generation garment merchant family with roots in 1973 (grandfather's shop) and Ming Lang Ge (MLG) established by the father in 1998. The international branch JYG began in 2025.
- Clients served: 2,000+ brands across 50+ countries
- Design service: free (tech pack work, size chart, pattern making)
- Shipping: 50+ countries
- Industries: t-shirts, hoodies and sweatshirts, jackets, snap shirts, private label apparel
- Fabric library: 12 stocked fabric families (single jersey, double pique, French terry, light and heavy fleece, polar fleece, rib knit, scuba, twill, waffle, jacquard, mesh); fabric links point to partner mill Jufeng Textile on Alibaba.com

## Product range

- T-shirts: Boxy Tee, Cropped Boxy Tee, Oversized Boxy Tee, Slim-fit Boxy Tee, Drop-Shoulder SS Tee, Layered Sleeve Tee, Oversized Long-Sleeve Tee, Sleeveless Boxy Tee
- Hoodies and sweats: Basic Full-Zip Hoodie, Minimalist Full-Zip Hoodie, Curved Seam Panel Zip Hoodie, Pullover Hoodie, Cropped Hoodie
- Jackets and shirting: Contrast Piping Mock Neck Jacket, Retro Track Jacket, Baseball Snap Shirt

## Manufacturing process (10 stages)

1. Consulting - style / previous work sharing, tech pack, fabric and techniques
2. Documentation - pre-production file
3. Sampling Terms - sample cost, estimated bulk price, timeline, payment link
4. Patterning - size chart and pattern making
5. Sample Making - fabric and trim sourcing, secondary processes, sewing, shipping
6. Sample Evaluation - buyer review, revision and approval
7. Quotation - unit pricing, customized accessories, deposit
8. Sourcing - raw material sourcing and trim customization, mold making
9. Grading - size grading and final specs verification
10. Fulfillment - bulk production, QC inspection, packaging, remaining payment, shipping

### Fabric library pages (12)

- [Double Pique](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-double-pique.html): Premium polo shirts, golf shirts, casual tops and smart sportswear. 200-280 gsm.
- [French Terry](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-french-terry.html): Hoodies, sweatshirts, joggers, sweatpants and casual sets. 220-320 gsm.
- [Heavy Fleece](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-heavy-fleece.html): Heavyweight hoodies, sweatshirts, joggers, winter sets and premium streetwear. 320-450 gsm.
- [Jacquard](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-jacquard.html): Polo shirts, premium tops, dresses, sweaters and fashion-led collections. 180-350 gsm.
- [Light Fleece](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-light-fleece.html): Mid-weight hoodies, children's wear, sweatshirts and layering pieces. 240-300 gsm.
- [Mesh](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-mesh.html): Sportswear, training tops, golf apparel, athletic lining, ventilation panels and performance clothing. 100-220 gsm.
- [Polar Fleece](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-polar-fleece.html): Fleece jackets, hoodies, sweatshirts, blankets and outdoor clothing. 180-300 gsm.
- [Rib Knit](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-rib-knit.html): T-shirt collars, cuffs, waistbands, fitted tops, dresses and casualwear. 180-350 gsm.
- [Scuba](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-scuba.html): Structured hoodies, sweatshirts, dresses, skirts, jackets and contemporary casualwear. 250-350 gsm.
- [Single Jersey](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-single-jersey.html): T-shirts, tank tops, casual tops, dresses and everyday basics. 140-220 gsm.
- [Twill](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-twill.html): Chinos, trousers, overshirts, jackets, uniforms and workwear. 180-350 gsm.
- [Waffle](https://jyggarment.com/fabric-waffle.html): Long-sleeve tops, thermal wear, sweatshirts, loungewear and casual sets. 180-300 gsm.
